## Keeping up with Elon Musk's children
- Elon Musk has 13 children he has confirmed, and a possible 14th child whose paternity is now being determined by a New York court.
- Musk, the world's richest man, has six children with his ex-wife, Justine Wilson.
- Musk shares three children with musician Grimes.
- The tech billionaire also has four children with tech executive Shivon Zilis.

Over more than two decades, he has fathered at least 14 children with multiple partners.

## **Elon Musk's children, by relationship:**
- Six children with his ex-wife, Justine Wilson, including their first child, a boy named Nevada, who died as an infant.
- Three children with musician Grimes, whose legal name is Claire Elise Boucher.
- Four children with tech executive Shivon Zilis.

## Nevada Alexander Musk (2002 -2002) — with Justine Wilson
Musk and his first wife welcomed their first child, a son, in 2022.

## Griffin Musk (2004) — with Justine Wilson
After the death of their son, Nevada, Musk and Wilson welcomed their first set of multiple children: a pair of twins.

## Kai Musk (2006) — with Justine Wilson
The three children are Kai, Saxon and Damian.

web.description:
The Tesla mogul has at least 14 children with four women.

Musk welcomed six kids with his first wife, Justine Wilson, three with his ex-girlfriend Grimes, four with his Neuralink executive [Shivon Zilis](https://pagesix.com/2022/07/07/who-is-shivon-zilis-meet-reported-mother-of-elon-musks-twins/) and reportedly another one with author Ashley St.

Elon Musk is a father of 14.

## **Nevada Alexander Musk**
Musk’s eldest child, son Nevada, died in 2002 at 12 weeks old.

## Techno Mechanicus
Grimes is believed to have welcomed her and Musk’s third child together in 2022. grimes/Instagram

The tech giant quietly [welcomed a third child with Grimes](https://pagesix.com/2023/09/09/elon-musk-confirms-he-had-third-child-with-grimes-named-techno-mechanicus/), named Techno Mechanicus, [according to Walter Isaacson’s biography “Elon Musk,”](https://r.pagesixlink.com/?btn_ref=org-282f0dd399864b44&btn_url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.amazon.com%2FElon-Musk-Walter-Isaacson%2Fdp%2F1982181281%2F%3Ftag%3Dpagesix-20%26asc_refurl%3Dhttps%3A%2F%2Fpagesix.com%2Farticle%2Felon-musk-children%2F%26asc_source%3Dweb) published in September 2023.

## Arcadia
Musk and Zilis quietly welcomed baby No. 3 in early 2024.

Bloomberg reported in June 2024 that Musk and Zilis [had a third child together](https://pagesix.com/2024/06/22/parents/elon-musk-secretly-welcomed-third-child-with-shivon-zilis-earlier-this-year-report/) at the start of the year.

Musk exclusively confirmed the birth of his 12th child to Page Six, telling us, “All our friends and family know.”

## Seldon Lycurgus
In February 2025, the same day Zilis announced the name of the couple’s third child, she revealed she [gave birth to a baby boy](https://pagesix.com/2025/02/28/celebrity-news/elon-musk-welcomes-4th-child-with-shivon-zilis-son-named-seldon-lycurgus/) named Seldon Lycurgus.

Musk seemingly confirmed the news of their fourth child, replying with a heart emoji.
